=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text lb "["
text rb "]"
text msg "  \t  hello world \t\n "
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note white: space, tab, newline, vertical tab, form feed, carriage return
fn white c uchar to bool
ret or eq c 32 and ge c 9 le c 13
end
fn lead a view uchar * to ulong
for i ulong len a
if not white get a i
ret i
end
end
ret len a
end
fn trail a view uchar * to ulong
for i ulong len a
if not white get a sub sub len a 1 i
ret sub len a i
end
end
ret 0
end
fn show a view uchar * to void
emit lb
emit a
emit rb
emit nl
end
fn main to int
l = lead msg
t = trail msg
show msg
show part msg l sub len msg l
show part msg 0 t
show part msg l sub t l
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
[  	  hello world 	
 ]
[hello world 	
 ]
[  	  hello world]
[hello world]
</pre>
